blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: . Recent advances in generative image models have made many manipulated images highly realistic, raising the need for detectors that are not only accurate but also able to provide visual evidence for their decisions. In this paper, we present our solution to the Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge ( 2 ) on the XPlainVerse dataset ( 1 ) , where systems are required to predict whether an image is real or fake and generate both complex and simple explanations grounded in visible forensic cues. Our method follows a modular detection-and-explanation design. For the real/fake decision, we build a multi-backbone detector that combines several DINOv3 models with Mesorch manipulation-localization features, bringing together pretrained visual representations, DCT-aware cues, and multi-scale forensic information. To inject explanation evidence into the detector, we use a Grounding-DINO-based pseudo-mask generation pipeline that converts local artifact descriptions from training explanations into weak patch-level supervision for an Artifact Evidence Map. We further introduce a local patch-level contrastive objective that separates artifact and authenticity evidence in the detector feature space without requiring paired images or pixel-level manipulation masks. For language output, we use class-conditional Qwen3-VL models to generate complex explanations for fake and real predictions, followed by a GRPO-optimized text simplification model. The proposed methods were trained and evaluated on the challenge subset of XPlainVerse. On the full test split, our submission achieves 0.9349 detection accuracy, 0.5571 explanation score, and a 0.7456 final challenge score.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Recent progress in generative image models has made many manipulated images increasingly realistic and harder to verify. A useful deepfake detector should therefore return not only a binary authenticity label but also evidence supporting the prediction; visible cues help audit model decisions and understand failures.
blocks.zh: 遗传图像模型的近期进展使得许多被操纵的图像越来越现实,更难被验证. 因此,有用的深假探测器不仅应返回二进制真实性标签,而且应返回支持预测的证据;可见的提示有助于审计模型的决定并理解失败。

blocks.en: The Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge ( 2 ) directly targets this setting. It is built on XPlainVerse ( 1 ) , a large-scale dataset of real and manipulated images with image-level labels, complex explanations for technical users, and simple explanations for general users. The official score combines real/fake classification with semantic similarity, simplicity, and LLM-based grounding metrics that check whether explanations refer to the correct entities and visual evidence. This encourages methods that connect the authenticity decision to the image cues described in the explanations.
blocks.zh: 解释性深假检测挑战 (2) 直接针对此设置. 它建立在XPlainVerse (1)上,一个由真实和被操纵的图像组成的大型数据集,带有图像级别标签,技术用户的复杂解释,普通用户的简单解释. 官方分数结合了真实/假分类与语义相似性,简洁,和基于LLM的地平分度量,检查解释是否指向正确的实体和视觉证据. 这鼓励将真实性决定与解释中描述的图像提示联系起来的方法.

blocks.en: Our solution separates real/fake detection from explanation generation. For the detector, we follow recent robust AI-generated image detection challenge results, where strong submissions often use ensembles of large pretrained visual backbones, especially DINOv3-based models ( 3 , 4 ) . We use several DINOv3 backbones and complement them with Mesorch features ( 5 ) , which provide DCT-aware, multi-scale forensic representations.
blocks.zh: 我们的解决方案将真实/假检测与解释生成分开。 对于探测器,我们遵循最近强健的AI生成的图像检测挑战结果,强大的提交材料经常使用被预先训练出大型视觉骨干组合,特别是基于DINOv3的模型(3,4). 我们使用几个DINOv3主干线,并以Mesorch特性(5)作为补充,这些特性提供DCT-意识,多尺度的法证表述.

blocks.en: To pass artifact information into the detector, we convert local artifact cues from fake-image explanations into weak patch-level pseudo-masks with a Grounding-DINO-based pipeline ( 6 , 7 ) . These masks encourage the detector to use visible, semantically grounded manipulation evidence when available.
blocks.zh: 为了将文物信息传递到探测器中,我们把本地文物提示从假象解释转换成有地平-地平地-地平地-地平地-地平地-地平地-地平地-地平地-地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平平平地平平平平地平地平地平地平 这些口罩鼓励探测器在有可见的,有固定基础的操纵证据时使用.

blocks.en: We further adapt contrastive learning to the patch level, following the motivation of DRCT ( 8 ) and HiDA-Net ( 9 ) : image-level contrastive objectives can improve fake-image separation, while local predictions encourage attention to fine forensic details. Our objective operates on patch embeddings and separates local fake and authentic evidence without paired images or pixel-level manipulation masks.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步按照DUFT(8)和HiDA-Net(9)的动机,使对比性学习适应补丁水平: 图像级对比性目标可以改善假相分离,而局部预测则会鼓励注意精细的法证细节. 我们的目标在补丁嵌入上操作,将局部的假证据和正宗证据分开,没有配对图像或像素级的操纵口罩.

blocks.en: For explanation generation, we use class-conditional Qwen3-VL models ( 10 ) selected by the detector prediction, followed by a text-only simplification model optimized with GRPO ( 11 ) . This keeps classification in a specialized detector and uses VLMs for the challenge language outputs.
blocks.zh: 对于解释生成,我们使用由探测器预测所选择的类有条件的Qwen3-VL模型(10个),然后使用GRPO(11个)优化的仅文本简化模型. 这保持了专用探测器的分级,并使用VLM进行挑战语言输出.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are (I) a pseudo-mask pipeline that extracts local forensic cues from complex explanations and grounds the corresponding image regions to obtain weak patch-level supervision, and (II) an explainable deepfake detection system combining DINOv3 and Mesorch features, patch-level artifact supervision, local contrastive learning, and class-conditional Qwen3-VL explanation generation.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献是(一) 从复杂的解释中提取本地法证提示并证明相应图像区域获得薄弱的补丁级监督的伪面具管道,(二) 结合DINov3和Mesorch特性的可解释的深假检测系统,补丁级文物监督,本地对比性学习,以及阶级条件的Qun3-VL解释生成.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Datasets
blocks.zh: 2.1. 数据集

blocks.en: Image-level synthetic-image benchmarks mainly target real/fake classification. GenImage ( 12 ) pairs ImageNet real images with GAN- and diffusion-generated counterparts. WildFake ( 13 ) contains over 3.5M real and fake images and organizes generators by model family, architecture, weights, and version, while Community Forensics ( 14 ) collects 2.7M images from 4,803 text-to-image models. These datasets are valuable for cross-generator generalization, but they mostly contain fully synthetic images and lack the explanation annotations required here.
blocks.zh: 图像级合成图像基准主要针对真实/假分类. GenImage (12 ) 与 GAN 和 扩散生成的对等对等对等对等对等的 ImageNet 真实的图像. WildFake (13 )包含超过3.5M真实和假图像,并按模型家族,建筑,重量,和版本组织出发电机,而社区法证 (14 )从4,803个文本到图像模型收集出2.7M图像. 这些数据集对于跨生成体通论很有价值,但它们大多包含完全合成的图像并缺少此处需要的解释说明.

blocks.en: MultiFakeVerse ( 15 ) is closer to realistic misinformation scenarios, with 86,952 real and 758,041 person-centric manipulations involving people, objects, scenes, actions, and human–object interactions. Recent datasets also move toward explainable detection. DD-VQA ( 16 ) reformulates face forgery detection over FaceForensics++ ( 17 ) as visual question answering. FakeClue, introduced with FakeVLM ( 18 ) , contains more than 100K real and synthetic images with natural-language artifact explanations. LOKI ( 19 ) evaluates multimodal models across images, video, 3D, text, and audio using judgment, multiple-choice, abnormal-detail, and abnormal-explanation questions. Their formats, annotation protocols, and artifact distributions nevertheless differ from the challenge data.
blocks.zh: MultifakeVerse(15个)更接近于现实的假象,有86,952个真实的和758,041个以人为中心的操纵,涉及人、物体、场景、行动以及人与对象的相互作用。 最近的数据集也转向了可解释的检测. DD-VQA (16 ) 在FaceForensics++ (17 ) 上重写出面部伪造检测,作为视觉问题回答. FakeClue由FakeVLM (18 )所引入,包含有100多克真实和合成的图像并有自然语言的文物解释. LOKI(19)评价跨图像,视频,3D,文本的多模式模型,以及使用判断,多选择,异常细节,异常解释问题等音频. 然而,其格式、注释协议和文物分布与挑战数据不同。

blocks.en: 2.2. Methods

AI-generated image detectors use reconstruction cues, as in AEROBLADE ( 20 ) ; CLIP-based adaptation, as in FatFormer ( 21 ) ; or frequency information, as in SPAI ( 22 ) . Recent challenge results show the practical strength of large pretrained backbones and ensembles. The NTIRE 2026 Robust AI-Generated Image Detection Challenge ( 3 ) reports strong systems based on transformer ensembles, DINOv3 models ( 4 ) , robustness augmentation, and fusion, motivating our multi-backbone design.
blocks.zh: AI生成的图像探测器使用重建提示,如AEROBLADE(20);基于CLIP的适应,如FatFormer(21);或频率信息,如SPAI(22). 最近的挑战结果表明,经过预先培训的大型骨干和组合具有实际力量。 NTIRE 2026强力AI-Generated影像检测挑战(3)报道了基于变压器组合的强力系统,DINOv3型号(4),强力增强和聚变,激励了我们的多后骨设计.

blocks.en: DRCT ( 8 ) applies image-level contrastive learning to separate real, generated, and diffusion-reconstructed samples. HiDA-Net ( 9 ) emphasizes spatial sensitivity to local edits, showing that local predictions can force attention to subtle forensic details. These ideas motivate our dense features and patch-level objective in addition to global classification.
blocks.zh: DRCT (8 ) 应用图像级对比性学习来分离出真实的,生成的,并进行扩散-重建的样本. HiDA-Net (9 )强调对本地编辑的空间敏感性,表明本地预测可以迫使人们注意微妙的法证细节. 除了全球分类之外,这些想法还激励着我们密集的特征和补丁级目标。

blocks.en: Manipulation localization is especially relevant when only a small region is fake. TruFor ( 23 ) combines RGB evidence with noise-sensitive representations, CAT-Net ( 24 ) exploits RGB-DCT compression cues, and Mesorch ( 5 ) combines DCT-aware inputs with multi-scale forensic features. We include Mesorch because its frequency-aware, localization-oriented representation complements DINOv3.
blocks.zh: 当一个小区域是假的时,操纵本地化尤其相关. TruFor (23 ) 结合了 RGB 证据和对噪声敏感的表示,CAT-Net (24 ) 利用了 RGB-DCT 压缩提示,而Mesorch (5 ) 结合了 DCT-意识输入和多尺度的法证特征. 我们把Mesorch包括进来,因为它的频率感知度,以本地化为取向的表示补充了DINOv3.

blocks.en: Vision-language models are increasingly used for explainable fake-image detection. FakeVLM ( 18 ) fine-tunes a multimodal model, including its visual encoder, for detection and artifact explanation. ForenDeX ( 25 ) injects detector-guided forensic features into an MLLM, while FakeXplainer ( 26 ) combines visual-encoder adaptation, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO. These works show that VLMs are useful for explanation, but their visual components often need forensic adaptation; we therefore separate a specialized detector from class-conditional explanation generators.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型被越来越多地用于可解释的假象检测. FakeVLM (18 ) 微调了一种多式联运模型,包括其视觉编码器,用于检测和文物解释. ForenDEX (25 )将探测器-制导的法证特征注入了MLLM,而FakeXplainer (26 )结合了视觉-编码器的适应,监督微调,以及GPRO. 这些作品显示VLM对解释很有用,但是它们的视觉组件往往需要法医学的改造;因此我们从类条件解释生成器中分离出专门的探测器.

blocks.en: 3. XPlainVerse Dataset and Challenge Subset
blocks.zh: 3. XPlainVerse 数据集与挑战子集

blocks.en: XPlainVerse ( 1 ) is the largest dataset for explainable deepfake detection, containing one million real and manipulated images paired with natural-language explanations. A substantial portion of it is based on the person-centric MultiFakeVerse dataset ( 15 ) . The Explainable Deepfake Detection Challenge ( 2 ) uses a curated 760,000-image subset: 270,000 real and 490,000 fake images. The public train, validation, and test splits contain 450,000, 110,000, and 200,000 images, respectively; labeled train–validation data comprise 180,000 real and 380,000 fake images, and the test split contains 90,000 real and 110,000 fake images.
blocks.zh: XPlainVerse (1 )是用于解释性深假探测的最大数据集,包含一百万个真实和被操纵的图像与自然语言解释对齐. 其中很大一部分是基于以人为中心的多假软件数据集(15.)。 "可解释的Deepfake检测挑战"(2 )使用一个被曲解的76万-图像子集:27万个真实和49万个假相. 公共列车,验证,测试分拆分别包含45万,11万和20万图像;被标注的列车-验证数据由18万真实和38万假图像组成,测试分拆包含9万真实和11万假图像.

4.2. Detector

blocks.en: 4.3.1. Class-conditional Complex Explanation Models
blocks.zh: 4.3.1. 类别复杂解释模式

blocks.en: The complex explanation is the primary evidence-bearing text output. We train separate generators for fake and real images to reduce class leakage, especially hallucinated artifacts for real images: G fake : I i ↦ e ^ i , fake c , G real : I i ↦ e ^ i , real c . blocks.en: 4.3.2. Supervised Fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 4.3.2. 监督的微调

blocks.en: Both generators are LoRA-adapted from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. LoRA is applied to all linear layers, while the vision tower is frozen to reduce memory cost and preserve the pretrained visual representation. We train on the public labeled data and reserve an internal subset for model selection and qualitative checking. Because real images are less frequent, they are oversampled when training the real-explanation branch.
blocks.zh: 这两台发电机都是由Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct改造而来. LoRA被应用到所有线性地层上,而视觉塔被冷冻以降低内存成本并保存被预先训练的视觉表现. 我们根据公共标注的数据进行培训,并保留一个内部子集,用于模型选择和质检。 由于真实图像的频率较低,因此在训练真实解析分支时会被过度采样.

blocks.en: 4.3.3. Complex-to-simple Explanation Model
blocks.zh: 4.3.3. 复杂到简单的解释模式

blocks.en: The challenge also requires an explanation for general users. We train a text-only simplifier, e ^ i s = S ⁡ ( e ^ i c ) \hat{e}_{i}^{s}=S(\hat{e}_{i}^{c}) , which makes inference and GRPO rollouts cheaper. Real-image complex and simple explanations are often nearly identical, so fake-image pairs provide most of the simplification signal. After supervised fine-tuning, S S is optimized with GRPO ( 11 ) using the official simple-explanation score.
blocks.zh: 这一挑战还要求对一般用户作出解释。 我们只训练一个文本简化器,e ^ i s = S → (e ^ i c ) ),这使得推论和GRPO推出更便宜. 真实图像复杂而简单的解释往往几乎完全相同,因此假图像对提供大部分简化信号. 在经过监督的微调后,S与GRPO(11 )采用官方的简单解说分数进行优化.

blocks.en: 6. Discussion
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 讨论情况

blocks.en: The proposed system achieved strong final results in the challenge setting, but it is computationally heavy. It combines several DINOv3 backbones, Mesorch features, and multiple Qwen3-VL models. This complexity is acceptable for a challenge submission, but it makes the method expensive and less attractive for practical deployment.
blocks.zh: 拟议的系统在挑战背景下取得了强有力的最终结果,但计算起来却很沉重。 它结合了多个DINOv3主干,Mesorch特性,以及多个Qune3-VL模型. 这种复杂性对于提交质疑文件来说是可以接受的,但它使这种方法昂贵,对实际部署的吸引力也较小。

blocks.en: A key limitation is that the LLM/VLM component is used mostly as an attachment to the detector. The detector first makes the real/fake decision, and the class-conditional Qwen3-VL model then generates an explanation for the predicted class. This improves the challenge-format output, but it does not fully use the reasoning potential of multimodal language models: the VLM does not participate in the authenticity decision, compare alternative hypotheses, or verify detector evidence.
blocks.zh: 一个关键限制是LLM/VLM组件大多被用作探测器的附件. 探测器首先作出真实/假的决定,而类条件的Qune3-VL模型再生成对所预测的类的解释. 这改善了挑战-格式输出,但并没有充分利用多模式语言模型的推理潜力:VLM没有参与真实性判断,比较替代假说,或者验证探测器证据.

blocks.en: Although GRPO improves the official metrics for simple explanations, especially normalized SLE, this does not necessarily mean that they become substantially more useful or accessible to ordinary users.
blocks.zh: 虽然GRPO改进了官方的度量衡来进行简单的解释,特别是规范化的SLE,但这并不一定意味着这些度量衡会大大地变得更为有用或为普通用户所取用.

blocks.en: 7. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 结论

blocks.en: We presented a modular solution for explainable deepfake detection trained and evaluated on the XPlainVerse challenge subset ( 1 ) . The system combines a multi-backbone forensic detector, explanation-grounded pseudo-mask supervision, local patch-level contrastive learning, class-conditional Qwen3-VL explanation generation, and GRPO-based simplification. On the final test split, it achieved 0.9349 detection accuracy, a 0.5571 explanation score, and a 0.7456 final challenge score.
blocks.zh: 我们在XPlainVerse挑战子集(1)上提出一个模块解决方案,用于对可解释的深假检测进行训练和评估。 该系统结合了多背骨法证检测器,解释基假面具监督,局部补丁级对比性学习,阶级条件的Qune3-VL解释生成,以及基于GPRO的简化. 在最终的测试分出后,它实现了0.9349检测精度,0.5571解释分,以及0.7456最终挑战分.

blocks.en: In validation, ablations indicate that local supervision derived from explanations improves detector generalization, with a further gain from local contrastive learning. GRPO-based simplification also improves the official simple-explanation score and contributes to the final result.
blocks.zh: 在验证中,分解表明由解释所衍生出的地方监督可以改善探测器通俗化,进一步从地方对比性学习中获益. 基于GPRO的简化也改善了官方的简单解释分数,并有助于最终结果.
